site_name: Land to the East of Moorhead Way, Kidbrooke Village - Phase 2 West, London, SE3 9FA
description: An application submitted under section 96a of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a non-material amendment in connection with the planning permission dated 13/08/2019 (Reference: 18/1948/F) for Construction of 85 residential units (22 x 1 bed, 61 x 2 bed and 2 x 3 bed) with associated car parking, landscaping, cycle parking and refuse storage. To allow:  Alteration to building footprint and layout and associated landscaping amendments; Increase in the width of the building by 1490mm; Increase in building height by 1300mm and subsequent amendments to the Finished Floor Levels; Reconfiguration of the windows and doors; Reduction in visitor car parking from 4 to 2 spaces, as a result of the proposed landscape amendments; Revisions to the location and increase in quantum from 15 to 16 easily adaptable wheelchair units;  Variations to the unit mix
